about.heading: About
about.narrative: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer with 4+ years of experience building native Android and cross-platform apps. I specialize in Kotlin, Clean Architecture, and declarative UI (Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI), with a track record of driving real performance gains, leading technical refactors, and mentoring engineers. I'm now expanding into multi-platform architecture (KMP) and AI-driven workflows.
